defs.def: material made by weaving or knitting cotton, wool, silk, etc. 布；布料

ex.s: As people now choose to wear more clothes fewer ___57___ (time), clothing rental services have become increasingly popular.
ex.t: 随着人们现在选择更少次地穿衣服（___57___），服装租赁服务……

ex.s: “I think it’s an amazing idea,” says Tanya Perilli, who owns a clothing rental shop.
ex.t: 我认为这是个很棒的主意，”经营一家服装租赁店的Tanya Perilli说。

ex.s: ●Put different types of clothing on different surfaces in the room.____19____.
ex.t: 交换活动的基本规则之一是每个人必须在拿走衣服之前试穿——穿上的效果看起来总是不一样的。

ex.s: Tanya is also looking beyond special-occasion dresses to less formal clothing, ___63___ she plans to package as capsule wardrobes and offer to travellers, such as those headed to weddings abroad, with a longer-term rental period.
ex.t: Tanya还把目光从特殊场合的礼服投向更休闲的服装，___63___她计划打包成胶囊衣橱，提供给旅行者（比如去国外参加婚礼的人），租期更长。

ex.s: Not only do they provide us with food, clothes and oxygen to breathe, but they also make our surroundings more beautiful.
ex.t: 它们不仅为我们提供食物、衣服和氧气，还使我们的环境更加美丽。

ex.s: She can be seen worn/wearing mermaid clothing and dived/diving up to 50 feet underwater to swim with dolphins, sharks and whales.
ex.t: 可以看到她穿着/穿着美人鱼服装，在水下50英尺深处潜水/潜水，与海豚、鲨鱼和鲸鱼一起游泳。

ex.s: I no longer felt the weight of my clothes, or of my shoes, of my air supply, or my thick helmet, inside which my head shook like a nut in its shell.
ex.t: 我不再感觉到我的衣服、鞋子、空气供应或厚厚的头盔的重量，我的头在里面像坚果一样摇晃。

defs.def: a piece of cloth, often used for a special purpose, especially cleaning things or covering a table 常构成复合词

ex.s: Growing up, my family and our neighbors never used clotheslines to dry clothing, denying me the chance ____62____ (discover) one of the great wonders of sunshine — the sweet “sunshine scent” after sunning clothes for an entire day.
ex.t: 成长过程中，我家和邻居从不使用晾衣绳晾衣服，使我失去了____62____（发现）阳光的一大奇迹的机会——把衣服晒上一整天后那甜美的“阳光味”。

ex.s: I stuffed a piece of cloth into the hole and took her outside, closing the door securely behind me.
ex.t: 我把一块布塞进洞里，把她带到外面，随手把门牢牢关上。

ex.s: On the edge of the jacket, there is a piece of cloth ___58___gives off light in the dark.
ex.t: 在夹克边缘，有一块在黑暗中___58___发光的布。

ex.s: If it is too cold, cover it with cloth beforehand.
ex.t: 如果太冷，请事先用布覆盖。

ex.s: Somehow I couldn’t do it myself, so I went around and got a plain clothes man to do the job.
ex.t: 不知何故，我自己做不到，所以我四处走走，找了一个便衣男来做这项工作。
